notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Gauntlet of Power.
You control at least six basic Islands.
description:
Activate six basic Islands by tapping them, adding six {U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers six times, adding six {U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the six Islands and up to one additional land you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
